[IARC.3.5.2] In addition to per-verb routing, the dispatcher owns
the typed integrator-callback table for the action
verbs that need one — call, cache / cache_delete. Each verb's handler
decodes the rule's RHS args, invokes the matching
typed callback if registered, surfaces errors via
the engine pending slot. NULL callback is a silent
drop for non-essential verbs (log) and an
explicit error code for essential ones (storage when
storage-required). See [IARC.1.14] for the discipline.
